name: Open Source Mobile App and Ad Analysis

mentions.name: Open Source Mobile App and Ad Analysis
mentions.description: Open source project for mobile app and ad analysis; the author is integrating Stripe to add a payment flow so people can pay for the project.
mentions.problem: The project lacked a good flow for people to pay the developer, prompting the Stripe integration.
mentions.source_excerpt: Finally integrating Stripe! Been working on open source mobile app and ad analysis for awhile but didn't have a good flow for people to pay me. After getting 3 emails in the past month about it, and with plenty of pressure from my wife, it's definitely time.
